tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha s+ya sā dha ka bi hā ra kṛ ti ri yaṃ bhu mi paṇ+ḍu paṇ+ḍi te na// ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i khro bo'i sgrub thabs sa skya pa mkhas pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems pa la/ /dgos pa gsum gyi lus dbul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi skur gyur/ hūm̐ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad du/

/log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sar+b+ba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang rdo rje bla bre la/ /'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi te/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ mā sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ mahā de ba dzaḥ u ma de bi dzaḥ pad+ma nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha phaṭa/ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi lpags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul rgyan gyi/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked bcings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la rgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab brdzis shing / /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched skra nyis khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang / rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med par gtams par gyur/ rang gi snying khar pad nyi'i steng du/

ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra/ mtshon gang pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du/ rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar/ kī la yas bskor ba/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ bh+rūm̐ bi mā na/ mā sūr+ya hūm̐/ dzñā na satwa kṛṣ+ṇa shū ka/ pañtsa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /gzig gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la rgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ /snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /'khor ba rdo rje grub par mdzod/ /oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ yang 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ /'khor ba rdo rje phur bu'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drang rang la thim pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa/ /sku gsung thugs su bdag bskyed cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yang 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /oṃ badz+ra shī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhi shwa ri taṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri hrī/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri a/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ khro bo rigs lngas dbu rgyan/ sras mchod bskyed na/ phur pa gcig gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ phur gdan la btsugs nas/ mdun du bzhag la/ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ sarba sha truṃ bigh+na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nān rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /srid pa rdo rje phur par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /hūm̐ dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs/ /srid pa rdo rje phur par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /badz+ra kī li kī li ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ shud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhī shwa ri traṃ/

oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri āḥ mā sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ ā tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ hūm̐ a/ oṃ hūm̐ swa a ha/ saṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ/ sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra añdza li hūm̐/ badz+ra ban+dha/ badz+ra añdza li dza/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i gug mo sgreng ba/ chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas phur bu bzung la/ dīp+ta tsakra phur bu'i lha/ /mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /lte ba man chad sku yi cha/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa/ /drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur na/ /gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ dīp+ta tsa kra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ dīp+ta rat+na kī li kī li ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ dīp+ta pad+ma kī li kī li ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ dīp+ta karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo yi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can rnams la 'bul/ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ badz+ra gīt+ti hriḥ badz+ra nirti aḥ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke hriḥ badz+ra gan+dhe a/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/

/rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod las/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la ban+dha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ mi zad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhe sdang thugs mchog yak+ṣa he ru ka/ /ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ /e ka dza ṭi gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum/ /rdo rje lha mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /khro mo dbang phyug yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces mchod cing bstod nas/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ dang / sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs thams cad/ rang 'dra'i skur bsdus nas thim pas/ rang gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs bzlas la ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam bzhin du bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs sgrol ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka ba tse hūm̐ phaṭa/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gi gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog/ //maṅga laṃ/ /e waṃ//
